text_block_list.name: TV Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's the last 200 meters! "Queen of the
Amazons" Hishi Amazon is in
hot pursuit of
the lead! Narita Brian's struggling in the
final straight!

Like the autumn Tenno Sho, the Japan
Cup was a bust...

Brian's winning streak felt like it could
have gone on forever... I
wonder what
happened as I watch videos of the races to
find a clue.

Following the agenda, the next race'll be
the Arima Kinen. There must
be a hint
somewhere to getting her previous
strength back.

text_block_list.name: TV Caster
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon finishes in a close second!
Narita Brian's fallen behind
and finishes
sixth!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
She's not drawing out all her energy. And
the low center of gravity
her form used to
have is—

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
She's not drawing out all her energy. And
the low center of gravity
her form used to
have is—
Knock, knock!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry to barge in.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Oh, a visit from you is rare.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Oh, a visit from you is rare.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, well, you're looking after my sister,
and I want to speak to you
about her.

Though she sounds relaxed, there's
concern in her expression. She
must be
more worried about Brian than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that her injury hasn't fully
healed yet...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's just a rumor. All you have to do is
watch her run to see that
she's recovered.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As I suspected. I can't imagine you would
let her overexert herself,
but her results
aren't improving.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Faced by that fact,
do you still intend for
her to run in the Arima
Kinen?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
As long as Brian wants to run,
I'm going to
respect her wishes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even though you don't know what's
causing the problem?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If she were to lose again in the Arima
Kinen, your guidance could be
called into
question. You'll have her run knowing
that?

That's definitely a real possibility.
But I
don't care.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heheh... Good, that's a relief to hear.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I came here to request that
she run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You did?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I see that wasn't necessary. You have
what's best for your
racers—for Brian—in
mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to say one thing though.
It's about
the time she lost the
autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised too when she placed
twelfth. Afterward I went to see
her, and...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: ...She was crying?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We're sisters, but I don't remember the
last time I saw tears streaming
down her
face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Racing isn't something she'd ever quit
easily.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So I hope you do everything you can to
help her... Please.

Hayahide may already understand what's
happened to Brian.

Deep in her eyes,
I see a sister's love. It's
clear she's putting a lot of
faith in me to
help her younger sibling.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
It's after hours,
Brian. The track's closed.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
It's after hours,
Brian. The track's closed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen's almost here,
so just give
it to me straight.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you here...
to tell me to stop training?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: No, I came to see how you're doing.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: No, I came to see how you're doing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: How I'm doing?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Hayahide about what
happened after the autumn Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I don't know enough to understand why
you were crying... yet.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I don't know enough to understand why
you were crying... yet.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But I do know that race was a big deal for
you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But I do know that race was a big deal for
you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I see. So you came to check up on me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What now? Are you going to tell me to
call off the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Crying just because I lost a race... You
think such a pitiful excuse of a
racer has
no right entering the Grand Prix, don't
you?!

Brian glares at me with piercing eyes,
almost growling out the words.

When I see that glimmer in her gaze, I
become sure of it.

When I see that glimmer in her gaze, I
become sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I am?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I think... I'm starting to understand the
reason for your tears. Your will
can't be
bent.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I think... I'm starting to understand the
reason for your tears. Your will
can't be
bent.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to let you run wild.
A trainer's
there to support their
racers.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to let you run wild.
A trainer's
there to support their
racers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I shouldn't have doubted you. Um...
thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Right, time to pull out all the stops!

I don't know why Brian can't get back to
normal, and I don't know
what brought her
to tears either.

But even so, I believe in her. Because in
that look of hers, I see only
determination.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian holds an ideal spot as she
enters the final straight! Will
this finally be
her day?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's impeccable positioning! All that's
left is to charge ahead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is the winner of the Kikuka
Sho, Mayano Top Gun! Narita
Brian's
fiercely chasing behind!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Go, Brian! Give us that good ol' sprint we
know and love!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But it looks like she's struggling!
Where's
that raw power Brian is
famous for?

Brian runs past our section of the stands,
and her expression comes
into clear view.

She's running as if clawing at the
ground in
pure desperation.

But she's unable to reach even the shadow
of Mayano Top Gun, and
her other
opponents soon catch up from behind.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: It's no use, she won't make it!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: The Brian we knew is no longer...

Her gaze never falters though. She hungers
for victory, never losing
sight of the finish
line.

As I watch her frantic attempt, I finally
understand.

Her losing streak isn't because of
"lingering pain" or "poor training." It's
because her old running style isn't
working
for her anymore.

She must've realized this during the
autumn Tenno Sho... and the
hopelessness
of it brought her to tears.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian can't shorten the gap! Mayano
Top Gun is unchallenged!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

But she continues on—she always pushes
forward.

All the pieces click into place in my
mind,
and I shout—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...C'mon, Briaaan!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Keep going, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Mayano Top Gun wins the race! With
the momentum from her
Kikuka Sho
victory, she's won the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian can't hold out and finishes
fourth!

I used to praise her boundless strength,
but this might be the first
time I shouted
to encourage her.

Though the result isn't what we hoped for,
I feel like we've made
progress—her as a
runner, and me as her trainer.

She'll never stop running toward victory.
That's what makes her the
best.
